mapper.select: SELECT date, device_model, os, user_count FROM device_statistics WHERE date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY), '%Y%m%d') ORDER BY date, user_count DESC
SELECT date, device_model, os, user_count FROM device_statistics WHERE date = #{date} ORDER BY user_count DESC
SELECT SUM(user_count) AS total_user_count FROM device_statistics
